title: 3573. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock V

examples.explanation: We can make $14 of profit through 2 transactions: A normal transaction: buy the stock on day 0 for $1 then sell it on day 2 for $9. A short selling transaction: sell the stock on day 3 for $8 then buy back on day 4 for $2.

We can make $36 of profit through 3 transactions: A normal transaction: buy the stock on day 0 for $12 then sell it on day 2 for $19. A short selling transaction: sell the stock on day 3 for $19 then buy back on day 4 for $8. A normal transaction: buy the stock on day 5 for $1 then sell it on day 6 for $19.
